card.name: Linking words before bleeding-reversal agents
card.fires_on: Small linking words or punctuation (of, and, commas, or, with) right before a bleeding-reversal agent is named, such as vitamin K, protamine, PCC, factor VIIa, tranexamic acid or desmopressin. Seen in anticoagulant bleeding and overdose passages.

modes.label: Of after administration
modes.description: The word "of" after a noun like administration or injection, just before a reversal agent.
modes.example: requiring blood transfusion and/or administration<< of>> vitamin K.

modes.label: Lists of reversal agents
modes.description: A comma, "and" or "or" inside a list of agents that may or may not reverse anticoagulant effects.
modes.example: protamine sulfate, vitamin K<<,>> and tranexamic acid

card.writes: It seems to prepare the model to name a reversal or hemostatic agent next.
